quarantine.mr_name: CIGAR-SEQ length mismatch must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: error_consensus: all SUTs must REJECT or CRASH on the malformed record; silent acceptance or silent record-drop is a conformance bug

evidence.quote: The sum of lengths of the M/I/S/=/X operations must equal the length of SEQ.

quarantine.mr_name: Flag bit exclusivity violation for unmapped segment must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: error_consensus: all SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when FLAG 0x4 is set but RNAME != '*' and POS > 0; silent acceptance is a conformance bug

evidence.quote: Bit 0x4: segment unmapped. If this bit is set, RNAME must be '*' and POS must be 0.

quarantine.mr_name: Optional tag with illegal type character must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: error_consensus: all SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when an optional tag's type character is not one of AifZHB; silent acceptance is a conformance bug

evidence.quote: The type character must be one of A, i, f, Z, H, or B.

quarantine.mr_name: TLEN sign consistency violation for paired reads must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: error_consensus: all SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when paired reads of the same template have same-signed TLEN values; silent acceptance is a conformance bug

evidence.quote: For paired reads, the two reads of a template must have equal magnitude but opposite sign TLEN values.
